children: Parabilis Medicines will present updated Phase 1/2 zolucatetide data in an oral Proffered Paper session at ESMO 2026 on Oct. 24.

Oral presentation scheduled for Saturday, October 24 during a sarcoma-focused Proffered Paper session at 2:45pm CEST (8:45am ET).
